metaDescription: Order custom long sleeve t shirts for your team. Perfect for uniforms, events, and workwear. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom long sleeve t shirts offer year-round versatility, from layering in cooler months to providing sun protection on outdoor job sites. Whether you need durable cotton for construction crews or moisture-wicking performance fabrics for event staff, long sleeves add coverage and professionalism. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on styles like the Carhartt Force® or Port & Company® essentials. Bulk orders ship quickly nationwide.
